scope: Offline inspection and software tests. No native drive was started in Phase 1; historical native metrics are quoted from their reports and keep their original source identities.

inspected_components.kinematic_prediction: Unranked physical alternatives; stationary people receive POSSIBLE_START, POSSIBLE_RETREAT and POSSIBLE_RUN (3.5 m/s, 6 m/s2). probability=None. rank_learned_modes rejects any >0.5 m motion of a currently stationary track (MEASURED_STATIONARY_OBJECT).
inspected_components.pedestrian_anticipation: crossing_forecast brakes for the first space-time conflict between any physical alternative and ego paths at 2/4/6/8 m/s2 over max(3 s, 0.6+v/5). cautious_roadside_speed admits 4/3/2/1 m/s caps only at ego speed <= 4.5 m/s.
inspected_components.active_safety: RULE supervisor: teacher, measured stopping envelope (clearance + v*reaction + v^2/(2a)), coverage speed limit, LiDAR path conflicts, pedestrian forecast; additional braking only; minimum brake hold and release rate.
inspected_components.control_scene: Sensor-only tracks from LiDAR/depth plus YOLO semantic association; motion tracking only for guided ROBOSPHERE, HYBRID, planner or recovery.
inspected_components.independent_prediction: Evaluator-side residual-MLP endpoint examples from native actor labels; failed admission.
inspected_components.rl: YaRabOstorha-Maneuver-v1 MaskablePPO with 18 frozen candidates and reward version 2.
inspected_components.crossing_comparison: Three validated Town10HD_Opt fixtures (crossing-a/b/c) with nine scheduled crossing participants each.

core_repair_pilot_20261014.maneuver_v1_hold_selection: 6000/6000 decisions in audited autonomous cases with CONTINUE admitted
